verses.translation: A Psalm for Asaph. The God of gods, the Lord, has spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun to the going down thereof.

translations.ron: Dumnezeul dumnezeilor, Domnul a grăit şi a chemat pământul,
translations.grk: Ψαλμὸς τῷ Ἀσάφ. Θεὸς θεῶν Κύριος ἐλάλησε, καὶ ἐκάλεσε τὴν γῆν ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν ἡλίου μέχρι δυσμῶν.

verses.translation: Out of Sion comes the excellence of his beauty.

translations.ron: De la răsăritul soarelui până la apus. Din Sion este strălucirea frumuseţii Lui.
translations.grk: Ἐκ Σιὼν ἡ εὐπρέπεια τῆς ὡραιότητος αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: God, our God, shall come manifestly, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall be kindled before him, and round about him there shall be a very great tempest.

translations.ron: Dumnezeu strălucit va veni, Dumnezeul nostru, şi nu va tăcea.
translations.grk: Ὁ Θεὸς ἐμφανῶς ἥξει, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, καὶ οὐ παρασιωπήσεται· πῦρ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ καυθήσεται, καὶ κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ καταιγὶς σφοδρά.

verses.translation: He shall summon the heaven above, and the earth, that he may judge his people.

translations.ron: Foc înaintea Lui va arde şi împrejurul Lui vifor mare.
translations.grk: Προσκαλέσεται τὸν οὐρανὸν ἄνω, καὶ τὴν γῆν διακρῖναι τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: Assemble ye his saints to him, those that have engaged in a covenant with him upon sacrifices.

translations.ron: Chema-va cerul de sus şi pământul, ca să judece pe poporul Său.
translations.grk: Συναγάγετε αὐτῷ τοὺς ὁσίους αὐτοῦ, τοὺς διατιθεμένους τὴν διαθήκην αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ θυσίαις.

verses.translation: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge. Pause.

translations.ron: Adunaţi-I Lui pe cuvioşii Lui, pe cei ce au făcut legământ cu El pentru jertfe.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀναγγελοῦσιν οἱ οὐρανοὶ τὴν δικαιοσύνην αὐτοῦ, ὅτι Θεὸς κριτής ἐστι· διάψαλμα.

verses.translation: Hear, my people, and I will speak to thee, O Israel: and I will testify to thee: I am God, thy God.

translations.ron: Şi vor vesti cerurile dreptatea Lui, că Dumnezeu judecător este.
translations.grk: Ἄκουσον λαός μου καὶ λαλήσω σοι, Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ διαμαρτύρομαί σοι· ὁ Θεὸς ὁ Θεός σου εἰμὶ ἐγώ.

verses.translation: I will not reprove thee on account of thy sacrifices; for thy whole-burnt-offerings are before me continually.

translations.ron: "Ascultă, poporul Meu şi-ţi voi grăi ţie, Israele!... Şi voi mărturisi ţie: Dumnezeu, Dumnezeul tău sunt Eu.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἐπὶ ταῖς θυσίαις σου ἐλέγξω σε, τὰ δὲ ὁλοκαυτώματά σου ἐνώπιόν μου ἐστὶ διαπαντός.

verses.translation: I will take no bullocks out of thine house, nor he-goats out of thy flocks.

translations.ron: Nu pentru jertfele tale te voi mustra, iar arderile de tot ale tale înaintea Mea sunt pururea.
translations.grk: Οὐ δέξομαι ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου σου μόσχους, οὐδὲ ἐκ τῶν ποιμνίων σου χιυάρους·

verses.translation: For all the wild beasts of the thicket are mine, the cattle on the mountains, and oxen.

translations.ron: Nu voi primi din casa ta viţei, nici din turmele tale ţapi,
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐμά ἐστι πάντα τὰ θηρία τοῦ δρυμοῦ, κτήνη ἐν τοῖς ὄρεσι, καὶ βόες.

verses.translation: I know all the birds of the sky; and the beauty of the field is mine.

translations.ron: Că ale Mele sunt toate fiarele câmpului, dobitoacele din munţi şi boii.
translations.grk: Ἔγνωκα πάντα τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ ὡραιότης ἀγροῦ μετʼ ἐμοῦ ἐστιν.

verses.translation: If I should be hungry, I will not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness of it.

translations.ron: Cunoscut-am toate păsările cerului şi frumuseţea ţarinii cu Mine este.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν πεινάσω, οὐ μή σοι εἴπω, ἐμὴ γάρ ἐστιν ἡ οἰκουμένη καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς.

verses.translation: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

translations.ron: De voi flămânzi, nu-ţi voi spune ţie, că a Mea este lumea şi plinirea ei.
translations.grk: Μὴ φάγομαι κρέα ταύρων, ἢ αἷμα τράγων πίομαι;

verses.translation: Offer to God the sacrifice of praise; and pay thy vows to the Most High.

translations.ron: Oare, voi mânca carne de taur, sau sânge de ţapi voi bea?
translations.grk: Θῦσον τῷ Θεῷ θυσίαν αἰνέσεως, καὶ ἀπόδος τῷ ὑψίστῳ τὰς εὐχάς σου.

verses.translation: And call upon me in the day of affliction; and I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me. Pause.

translations.ron: Jertfeşte lui Dumnezeu jertfă de laudă şi împlineşte Celui Preaînalt făgăduinţele tale.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπικάλεσαί με ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεως, καὶ ἐξελοῦμαί σε, καὶ δοξάσεις με. διάψαλμα.

verses.translation: But to the sinner God has said, Why dost thou declare my ordinances, and take up my covenant in thy mouth?

translations.ron: Şi Mă cheamă pe Mine în ziua necazului şi te voi izbăvi şi Mă vei preaslăvi".
translations.grk: Τῷ δὲ ἁμαρτωλῷ εἶπεν ὁ Θεὸς, ἱνατί σὺ διηγῇ τὰ δικαιώματά μου, καὶ ἀναλαμβάνεις τὴν διαθήκην μου διὰ στόματός σου;

verses.translation: Whereas thou hast hated instruction, and hast cast my words behind thee.

translations.ron: Iar păcătosului i-a zis Dumnezeu: "Pentru ce tu istoriseşti dreptăţile Mele şi iei legământul Meu în gura ta?
translations.grk: Σὺ δὲ ἐμίσησας παιδείαν, καὶ ἐξέβαλες τοὺς λόγους μου εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω.

verses.translation: If thou sawest a thief, thou rannest along with him, and hast cast in thy lot with adulterers.

translations.ron: Tu ai urât învăţătura şi ai lepădat cuvintele Mele înapoia ta.
translations.grk: Εἰ ἐθεώρεις κλέπτην, συνέτρεχες αὐτῷ, καὶ μετὰ μοιχῶν τὴν μερίδα σου ἐτίθεις.

verses.translation: Thy mouth has multiplied wickedness, and thy tongue has framed deceit.

translations.ron: De vedeai furul, alergai cu el şi cu cel desfrânat partea ta puneai.
translations.grk: Τὸ στόμα σου ἐπλεόνασε κακίαν, καὶ ἡ γλῶσσά σου περιέπλεκε δολιότητα.

verses.translation: Thou didst sit and speak against thy brother, and didst scandalise thy mother's son.

translations.ron: Gura ta a înmulţit răutate şi limba ta a împletit vicleşug.
translations.grk: Καθήμενος κατὰ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου κατελάλεις, καὶ κατὰ τοῦ υἱοῦ τῆς μητρός σου ἐτίθεις σκάνδαλον.

verses.translation: These things thou didst, and I kept silence: thou thoughtest wickedly that I should be like thee; but I will reprove thee, and set thine offences before thee.

translations.ron: Şezând împotriva fratelui tău cleveteai şi împotriva fiului maicii tale ai pus sminteală.
translations.grk: Ταῦτα ἐποίησας, καὶ ἐσίγησα, ὑπέλαβες ἀνομίαν ὅτι ἔσομαί σοι ὅμοιος· ἐλέγξω σε, καὶ παραστήσω κατὰ πρόσωπόν σου.

verses.translation: Now consider these things, ye that forget God, lest he rend you, and there be no deliverer.

translations.ron: Acestea ai făcut şi am tăcut, ai cugetat fărădelegea, că voi fi asemenea ţie; mustra-te-voi şi voi pune înaintea fetei tale păcatele tale.

verses.translation: The sacrifice of praise will glorify me: and that is the way wherein I will shew to him the salvation of God.

translations.ron: Înţelegeţi dar acestea cei ce uitaţi pe Dumnezeu, ca nu cumva să vă răpească şi să nu fie cel ce izbăveşte.
